## What is PerfView?

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="60%"}

* A MIT-license tool for collecting / inspect performance data based on ETW(Event Tracing for Windows): <https://github.com/microsoft/perfview>
* Lightweight & fast for both collecting process-wide / system-wide performance data
* Don’t require software installation.<br/>(Simply copy the **PerfView.exe** and run it.)
 
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}

![]({{< meta perfview_intro_prefix >}}pics/download_perfview_exe.png)

:::

::::      

## ETW(Event Tracing for Windows)

* Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) provides an OS-level infra to trace and log events that are raised by user-mode applications and kernel-mode drivers
* Built-in with Windows, provides developers a fast, reliable, and versatile set of event tracing features
* Performance data collection tools that use ETW infra:
  * dotnet-trace
  * Windows Performance Analyzer
  * PerfView
  * JetBrains ETW Host Service: Provides ETW facilities for JetBrains dotTrace "Timeline Profiling" feature
